summary: Architectural blueprint and execution plan for Step 1: Facilitator Workspace enhancement. Features the persistent top navigation bar, the dual-section Facilitator Welcome Hub with actionable feature showcase and quick-start cards, the refined Editor View with dedicated Editor Context Bar (Slides count, Undo/Redo, Add Slide, editable Activity Name, and clickable Theme pill), dynamic multi-format Aspect Ratio switching (16:9, 16:10, 4:3) persisted in activity state, and clean File -> Close activity lifecycle.
